assessments.reasoning: Sections 1.3 and 4.2 give the implementation-independent core boundary and distinguish logical module source from its physical representation. Page 42 expressly separates export-tool content, including the version and leading Begin/End material, from the required module body grammar.

challenge.method: Read pp.41–42 in context. Check the grammar on the same page for module headers and attributes, and challenge any attempt to apply the rule to all Begin/End constructs or every host form export.
challenge.results: The specification limits the passage to implementation-tool material at the start of the module file and provides explicit grammar for module headers separately. The leading export format has a different remit from either genuine source or grammatical module attributes.

limitations: This judgment applies to the exact May 20, 2025 MS-VBAL revision 2.4. The publisher currently lists a later edition. Its requirements and behavior of any Office host are outside this review.
This does not qualify an Office serialization format, hosting API, module-header attribute set, or unrelated use of the words Begin and End.
